blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find \(S_n\) for the arithmetic series: \(a_1 = 4,\ n = 25,\ a_n = 100\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein series likhi hui nahi, balke us ki maloomat di gayi hai. Pehle dekhiye kya kya diya hai.
Diya kya hai? Pehli term \(a_1 = 4\), terms ki tadaad \(n = 25\) aur aakhri term \(a_n = 100\).
Find kya karna hai? Jama \(S_{25}\).
Plan: teeno cheezein seedhi \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) mein rakh deni hain; \(d\) ki zaroorat hi nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 4\), \(n = 25\), \(a_n = 100\).
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n = S_{25}\).
Tareeqa: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) ko bilkul yahi teen values chahiye: terms ki tadaad, pehli term aur aakhri term. Jab formula ki har cheez di hui ho to seedha rakh dena hi sab se samajhdari hai.

Values rakhein
\[S_{25} = \dfrac{25}{2}(4 + 100)\]
\[= \dfrac{25}{2} \times 104\]
Kyun: \(n = 25\), \(a_1 = 4\) aur \(a_n = 100\) formula mein apni apni jagah rakh diye. Pehle bracket hal kiya: \(4 + 100 = 104\).

Simplify karein
\[= 25 \times 52 = 1300\]
Kyun: 25 ko 2 se divide karne ke bajaye 104 ko 2 se divide kiya, kyunke 104 even hai aur fraction se bach gaye. \(25 \times 52\) aasaani se: \(25 \times 4 = 100\), to \(25 \times 52 = 100 \times 13 = 1300\).

Tasdeeq
\[d = \dfrac{100 - 4}{24} = 4\]
\[S_{25} = \dfrac{25}{2}[8 + 24(4)]\]
\[= \dfrac{25}{2}(104) = 1300 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a_{25} = a_1 + 24d\) se \(100 = 4 + 24d\), yani \(d = 4\). Ab doosra formula \(\frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n-1)d]\) lagaya to bhi 1300 aaya. Do alag raston se ek hi jawab aaye to bharosa barh jata hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(S_{25} = 1300\)
Yeh series 4, 8, 12, ..., 100 hai aur us ka jama 1300 hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find \(S_n\) for the arithmetic series: \(a_1 = 40,\ n = 20,\ d = -3\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan aakhri term nahi di, lekin common difference \(d\) di hui hai, aur woh bhi negative, yani series ghat rahi hai: 40, 37, 34, ...
Diya kya hai? \(a_1 = 40\), \(n = 20\), \(d = -3\).
Find kya karna hai? \(S_{20}\).
Plan: woh formula chunna hai jis mein \(a_1\), \(n\) aur \(d\) aate hain: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n-1)d]\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 40\), \(n = 20\), \(d = -3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(S_{20}\).
Tareeqa: Hamare paas do formulas hain. \(\frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) ko aakhri term chahiye jo nahi di. \(\frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n-1)d]\) ko \(a_1\), \(n\), \(d\) chahiye, jo teeno maujood hain. Is liye doosra formula.

Values rakhein
\[S_{20} = \dfrac{20}{2}[2(40) + 19(-3)]\]
\[= 10(80 - 57)\]
Kyun: \(2a_1 = 2 \times 40 = 80\). \((n - 1)d = 19 \times (-3) = -57\); negative \(d\) ka matlab hai har term pichhli se 3 kam hai.
Dhyan dein: \(d\) ka minus sign bracket ke saath rakhiye, \(19(-3)\); sign bhoolne se jawab \(10(80 + 57) = 1370\) aa jata hai jo ghalat hai.

Simplify karein
\[= 10 \times 23 = 230\]
Kyun: \(80 - 57 = 23\), phir 10 se multiply. Jama chhota is liye hai ke terms ghat rahi hain aur aakhir mein negative bhi ho jati hain.

Tasdeeq
\[a_{20} = 40 + 19(-3) = -17\]
\[S_{20} = 10(40 - 17)\]
\[= 10 \times 23 = 230 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Aakhri term nikal kar \(\frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) lagaya: \(a_1 + a_n = 40 + (-17) = 23\). Wohi 230 aaya. Is se yeh bhi pata chala ke series 40 se shuru ho kar \(-17\) par khatam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Find \(S_n\) for the arithmetic series: \(a_n = 52,\ n = 21,\ d = -4\).
blocks.explanation:
Is part mein ulta hai: pehli term nahi, aakhri term di hui hai.
Diya kya hai? \(a_n = 52\), \(n = 21\), \(d = -4\).
Find kya karna hai? \(S_{21}\).
Plan: pehle \(a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d\) se \(a_1\) nikalna, phir \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_n = 52\), \(n = 21\), \(d = -4\).
Humein find karna hai: \(S_{21}\).
Tareeqa: Dono sum formulas mein \(a_1\) chahiye, jo nahi di. Lekin \(a_n\), \(n\) aur \(d\) se \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) ke zariye \(a_1\) nikal sakte hain. Phir pehli aur aakhri dono maloom hongi, to \(\frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) sab se aasaan hoga.

Pehli term nikalein
\[a_{21} = a_1 + 20d\]
\[52 = a_1 + 20(-4)\]
\[52 = a_1 - 80\]
\[a_1 = 132\]
Kyun: 21st term tak pahunchne ke liye pehli term se 20 qadam lagte hain, har qadam \(-4\) ka. \(20 \times (-4) = -80\). Dono taraf 80 jama kiya to \(a_1 = 132\).
Dhyan dein: Kyunke \(d\) negative hai, series ghat rahi hai, is liye pehli term aakhri se bari honi chahiye: 132 > 52. Yeh sense check zaroor kijiye.

Jama nikalein
\[S_{21} = \dfrac{21}{2}(132 + 52)\]
\[= \dfrac{21}{2} \times 184\]
\[= 21 \times 92 = 1932\]
Kyun: Ab \(a_1 = 132\) aur \(a_n = 52\) dono maloom hain. Jama \(132 + 52 = 184\), us ka aadha 92, aur \(21 \times 92 = 1932\).

Tasdeeq
\[S_{21} = \dfrac{21}{2}[2(132) + 20(-4)]\]
\[= \dfrac{21}{2}(264 - 80)\]
\[= \dfrac{21}{2}(184) = 1932 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosre formula se bhi bilkul wohi 1932 aaya. Answer key bhi 1932 deti hai.
